properties.title: Kubernetes for SDI (development set up and production set up)
properties.description:
Spatial Data Infrastructure is an elusive concept, this workshop takes it to mean the set up of a multi node cluster for delivery of geospatial applications.

During the workshop participants will learn:
- How to set up Rancher Desktop on OSX/Windows/Linux for development
- The use of Kubernetes UI to inspect workloads/pods/persistent volumes and claims.
- Helm and the creation of a helm chart with Postgres (Postgis and timescaledb), GeoServer and GeoNode.
- Deployment of the same chart on a cloud based kubernetes service.

Workshop is based on work done for the island of Dominica from 2019 to 2022 on a consortium between Kartoza and Piensa Labs. Main engineers were Rizky Maulana, Wayner Barrios, Ricardo Silva and Ariel Núñez.
